title: 星巴克冰咖啡从韩国走向更多门店，怎样保证稳定出品？
topic: 把本地饮品创意转成可规模化复制的门店产品

source.title: What is the Starbucks Aerocano? Meet the air-whipped twist on the Iced Americano
source.section: What is the Starbucks Aerocano? Meet the air-whipped twist on the Iced Americano
source.type: 星巴克官方新品开发与跨市场推广案例
source.context: Starbucks 官方业务材料；本课练习围绕实际业务沟通任务。
source.captureMethod: Reader-captured excerpts from the linked official Starbucks source; article text and original URL verified in the web reader. Direct HTTP returned 403 and was not used for the capture.
paragraphs: The Aerocano’s Starbucks journey began in South Korea, where it debuted to customers earlier this year. In South Korea, the iced Americano is one of Starbucks most popular beverages – a daily ritual for many South Koreans, whether it’s a hot summer day or below freezing in the winter. It’s actually a global trend, customers with a taste for cold – about 60 percent of the beverages Starbucks sells globally are cold.

From there, Beppu turned to Vivian Luk, who leads research and development, and Aleksandra Orsolic, who oversees coffee product strategy for Starbucks Asia Pacific, to determine how Starbucks could bring the beverage to life in South Korea and at scale.
Their challenge wasn’t simply recreating the beverage. It was transforming it into a Starbucks beverage that could be crafted consistently by baristas across thousands of coffeehouses.
While the Aerocano appears simple on the surface, developing a recipe that consistently created the cascading effect and delivered the bright flavors took some time.

The team tested variables such as steam times and pouring the beverage over ice to achieve a velvety, slightly sweet texture while preserving the bright notes of the espresso shots from the first sip through the last.
translations: Aerocano 的星巴克之旅始于韩国，并于今年稍早在当地推出。在韩国，冰美式是星巴克最受欢迎的饮品之一，也是许多人的日常习惯，无论盛夏还是冬季严寒。冷饮其实是全球趋势：星巴克全球销售的饮品中，约 60% 是冷饮。
随后，Beppu 找到负责研发的 Vivian Luk，以及负责星巴克亚太咖啡产品策略的 Aleksandra Orsolic，共同研究如何在韩国把这款饮品打造出来，并使其能够规模化推广。
他们面临的挑战不只是复刻这款饮品，而是要把它改造成星巴克风格的饮品，让数千家门店的咖啡师都能稳定制作。
Aerocano 表面看起来简单，但研发出能稳定形成层叠效果、同时呈现清爽明亮风味的配方，花了一些时间。
团队测试了蒸汽时间、把饮品倒在冰块上的方式等变量，以获得丝滑、略带甜味的口感，同时从第一口到最后一口都保留浓缩咖啡清爽明亮的风味。

It’s actually a global trend, customers with a taste for cold – about 60 percent of the beverages Starbucks sells globally are cold.

From there, Beppu turned to Vivian Luk, who leads research and development, and Aleksandra Orsolic, who oversees coffee product strategy for Starbucks Asia Pacific, to determine how Starbucks could bring the beverage to life in South Korea and at scale.
Their challenge wasn’t simply recreating the beverage. It was transforming it into a Starbucks beverage that could be crafted consistently by baristas across thousands of coffeehouses.
While the Aerocano appears simple on the surface, developing a recipe that consistently created the cascading effect and delivered the bright flavors took some time.

The team tested variables such as steam times and pouring the beverage over ice to achieve a velvety, slightly sweet texture while preserving the bright notes of the espresso shots from the first sip through the last.

scenario.title: 星巴克新品：把 Aerocano 稳定推广到更多门店
english: Starbucks introduced the Aerocano in South Korea and wants to scale it across thousands of coffeehouses.
The drink needs a consistent cascading effect, a velvety, slightly sweet texture, and bright espresso notes.
Explain how to test steam times and pouring over ice, then confirm baristas can craft it consistently at scale.
chinese: 星巴克 Aerocano 冰咖啡在韩国推出，并计划推广到数千家门店。
这款饮品需要稳定的层叠效果、丝滑微甜的口感，以及明亮的浓缩咖啡风味。
请说明如何测试蒸汽时间和倒入冰块的方式，并确认咖啡师能否在不同门店稳定制作。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请根据这则星巴克案例，用英语概述 Aerocano 如何从韩国推广至更多门店、研发团队测试了什么，以及怎样保证咖啡师稳定制作。
firstAttempt.sample: The Aerocano first debuted in South Korea. To scale it across thousands of coffeehouses, the team tested steam times and how to pour the drink over ice. The goal was to create a velvety, slightly sweet texture while preserving the espresso’s bright notes. Baristas need to craft it consistently across stores.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先交代新品的推广背景，再说明研发测试的变量和要达到的口感，最后点出门店稳定出品的要求。

choice.prompt: 本地饮品很受欢迎，但不同门店做出的口味差异很大。推广前最应该做什么？
options: Send the recipe to every store and assume it will work.
Test preparation variables with baristas at several locations, then confirm flavor consistency and service speed during busy shifts.
Add more ingredients so every barista can adjust the drink freely.
choice.why: 第二条在不同门店和实际服务时段验证配方能否稳定复制。

output.prompt: 你要把一款冰咖啡从 6 家试点扩展到 200 家门店。请说明要测试的配方变量、参与测试的门店，以及扩大推广前的质量标准。
